traceability.notes: The story 024.0-DEV-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE-REFS is fully implemented. normalizeCommentLine implements a centralized backtick-span filter that removes any `...` content while preserving string length via spaces, and then runs the existing annotation detection logic. Unit tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format-internal.test.ts are explicitly tied to this story and its REQ IDs and cover: ignoring backtick-wrapped @story/@req, preserving spacing (including `@story` + `@req` documentation patterns), correctly exposing real @story annotations outside backticks on the same line, handling multiple backtick segments, and leaving non-backtick lines unchanged other than standard normalization. The full Jest suite passes, demonstrating no regressions. The function’s JSDoc documents the inline code filtering behavior. All acceptance criteria and listed requirements (REQ-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE, REQ-PRESERVE-BOUNDARIES, REQ-CENTRALIZED-FILTER) are satisfied with concrete test and code evidence.
